rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for someone formally undergoing workplace training.

example.english: The company arranged for the new colleague to be a trainee and learn the ropes.
example.traditional: 公司安排咗新同事做受訓員，熟習各項工作。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 on1 paai4 zo2 san1 tung4 si6 zou6 sau6 fan3 jyun4 suk6 zaap6 gok3 hong6 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this for a trainee learning under supervision, especially in an entry-level or probationary role.

example.english: This trainee has to work alongside the master for three months.
example.traditional: 呢個見習生要跟住師傅做足三個月。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gin3 zaap6 sang1 jiu3 gan1 zyu6 si1 fu2 zou6 zuk1 saam1 go3 jyut6

rows.note: Use this when the trainee is an intern gaining practical workplace experience, often as part of a course.

example.english: My daughter is a trainee at a hospital during the summer.
example.traditional: 我個女暑假去醫院做實習生。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 neoi2 syu2 gaa3 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 zou6 sat6 zaap6 sang1
